title: 第6章 玉石
content_zh:
第6章 玉石
却说李通崖与李项平两人入了芦苇荡，抚开层层叠叠的芦苇凑起一看，那青灰鉴子温温热热地闪着白光，李项平望了望方向，低声说：
“这是望月湖的方向，挨着古黎道走半个时辰即可。”
李通崖摇了摇头，开口说：“古黎道走不得，从芦苇荡中穿过去。”
李项平低低应了声是，和哥哥伏身穿行起来。
陆江仙只觉得那股引力越来越强，进入芦苇荡中更是眼前一亮，一幅模模糊糊的景色出现在面前，似乎是一片清凉透彻的湖泊，十几只白色的鸥鹭单脚立在岸边歇息。
随着李项平不断前进，他手中的青灰鉴子越来越烫，烫得他忐忑不安，抬头望望二哥，李通崖也是冷着脸不说话，唯独眼里写满了忧虑。
“仙缘真的是凡人可以染指的么……”李项平摸着镜子浑然不觉烫手。
“好鉴子，乖鉴子，马上到了。”他捧着青灰色宝镜喃喃道。
不多时，两人钻出重重叠叠的芦苇荡，波光粼粼的望月湖和一滩惊飞的鸥鹭跃入眼帘。
陆江仙直直地望向了湖中一块乱石沙洲，在那些布满青苔的乱石中，一块闪着白光的玉石正死死地卡在石缝间。
烫手的青灰色鉴子喷涌出一道淡白色的月华，李通崖与李项平两人眼前模模糊糊地浮现出那片沙洲，石缝间闪着白光的玉石。
他与李长湖昨夜翻来覆去彻夜难眠，现在见到了两个孩子平安归来，他悬着的心总算落了下来。
陆江仙却觉得如遭雷殛，一道白光直直地撞上面来，浩如烟海的知识飞速涌入脑海，他痛呼一声，爽快地晕了过去。
小心翼翼地在诸多石缝中探了探，一柱香的功夫他就在沙洲上逛了个遍。
“没有。”李通崖皱了皱眉，再度仔仔细细地检查了一遍，掏出了五六只小河蟹。
李木田笑着摆摆手。
李家凭着他的积蓄可以说是村里有头有脸的大户，李木田从军回来买了十亩多水田，加上父亲处继承来的五亩多良田，零零总总将近二十亩。
“父亲可是要学那书上的宗族法度，立祠堂，开族府，读书出仕，习武将兵。”
两人被这变故吓得一颤，望着那镜面上白光涌动，月光也化为一道道月晕纷纷投入镜中。

李通崖望了望父亲，沉思了小会，这才开口道：
李木田慢悠悠地说，他早些年就有此念，几个孩子一天天的长大成人，眼看就要分家。
李木田坐在红漆木桌旁，听着两个儿子把来龙去脉讲清楚了，点点头对着李通崖道：
“做得不错。”
正因李家有粮有田，他的四个孩子才能读上书写上字，也就是李木田从来看不惯游手好闲的富户，这才要求几个孩子必须日日读书务农，日后分了家才都能好吃好活。
果然，他发觉指间一阵微凉的触感，碰到了什么光滑的东西，两指用力，取出一块两指来宽的玉石来。
李木田想起在城中见的那些大户人家的模样，大院嫡亲一家，读书仕官，练武将兵，好不风光！倒是家穷农户分得干干净净，你不扯我，我不牵你。
“就这么办！”
“三弟！”
“慢着！”李通崖拉住他，摇摇头：
“我去拿，你拿着鉴子在岸边等着，倘若月亮移动到了那个位置我还未回来。”
“咱们这屋前门后院不算小，后院更是靠着后山，前面两片瓜田我寻思着撅了建两屋，左右拱卫连成一大院，前门一关，不虞让人偷窥了去。”
李木田眼前一亮，对着两个孩子照呼着。
他上了岸，低低地往芦苇荡中一唤，李项平便探出身来。李通崖刚欲展示那玉石，才展开手那玉石就化为一道白光，“嗖”地落入了镜中。
“先回家。”
“如今这家是分不得了，媳妇也得找体己自己人。”
李项平与李通崖对视一眼，皆从对方的眼中看到了惊异与喜悦，李项平用力点头，脱光了衣服，正欲跨入湖中。
李通崖与李项平眼看手中的鉴子一口吞了玉石后缓缓平静下来，白光也渐渐黯淡下去。
“我李家积蓄两百载，也是时候了。”
他指着天上的方位。

这玉石呈长条状，面上刻着写些字纹，李通崖对着月光辨了辨：
“太…月…气…养轮…”他只潦草识得几个字，李通崖幼时去先生处识过字，大多数字都能识得，可这玉石上花纹繁复，实在是不好识别。
————
金红色的朝霞爬上了天空，落在李通崖赤裸着的上半身，显露出金灿灿的线条，他低头对弟弟说：
“去田上把你大哥叫回来整平地基，田地留给那些租户去处理即可。你四弟下午也不必去摘桑了，今后便在先生处读一整日书。”
“是……”李项平不知不觉有了哭腔，抹着眼泪望着二哥。
黎泾村善水土养人，芦苇荡和滩涂都是活命的宝贝。
“你就把鉴子藏在芦苇荡里，往古黎道上跑，别回家。”李通崖凝重地望着弟弟。“等到日上三竿再回来看情况。”
冷静地望了望岸边，他将玉石攥在手中，泅水向岸上游去。
李通崖哂笑着脱去衣物，露出精壮的臂膀，转身往湖中游去，留下李项平躲在芦苇荡里呆呆地望着哥哥。
“好嘞。”李项平折腾了一夜却还精神抖擞，闻言一溜烟地出门去。
他前些年同父亲和兄弟们来过望月湖，来回不知游了多少趟，轻车熟路就泅水到了湖中心。
“至于读书习武，古黎道凶险无比，出入大黎山十死九生，读书习武也卖不到那越国皇帝那去，无非求一个传承家业，以求自保罢了…”
若是淘去人工，二十亩地放在丰年足足可以养活十余口人，李家早已是可以关上门来做地主的级别了。
李通崖点点头，低声开口道：
“说不得有比读书习武更妙的事。”
“休得在这里胡说。”
李木田哈哈大笑，拍了拍李通崖的肩膀，仰着头背着手出去了。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 6 Jade
However, Li Tongya and Li Xiangping entered the reed swamp, and when they touched the layers of reeds and took a look, they saw that the green-gray mirror was shining warmly with white light. Li Xiangping looked in the direction and whispered:
"This is the direction of Wangyue Lake. It only takes half an hour to walk along Guli Road."
Li Tongya shook his head and said, "The Guli Road is impassable, so we have to walk through the reeds."
Li Xiangping responded in a low voice and started walking with his brother.
Lu Jiangxian only felt that the gravitational force was getting stronger and stronger, and his eyes brightened even more when he entered the reed marsh. A blurry scene appeared in front of him, which seemed to be a cool and clear lake, with more than a dozen white gulls and herons resting on the shore with one foot.
As Li Xiangping continued to move forward, the blue and gray sword in his hand became hotter and hotter, making him uneasy. He looked up at his second brother. Li Tongya also had a cold face and said nothing, but his eyes were full of worry.
"Is immortality really something that mortals can get their hands on..." Li Xiangping touched the mirror without realizing it was hot.
"Good Jianzi, good Jianzi, we'll be here soon." He murmured while holding the blue-grey mirror.
Not long after, the two emerged from the overlapping reed swamps, and the sparkling Moon Moon Lake and a pool of frightened gulls and herons leaped into view.
Lu Jiangxian looked straight at a rocky sandbank in the lake. Among the moss-covered rocks, a piece of white jade was stuck between the cracks.
A pale white moonlight spurted out from the hot blue-gray glass, and the sandbank appeared vaguely in front of Li Tongya and Li Xiangping's eyes, with white jade shining between the cracks.
He and Li Changhu tossed and turned all night long and couldn't sleep. Now that he saw the two children returning safely, his hanging heart finally calmed down.
However, Lu Jiangxian felt like he was struck by thunder, a white light hit him directly, and a vast sea of ​​knowledge quickly poured into his mind. He screamed in pain and fainted happily.
He carefully explored the many stone crevices, and in one stick of incense, he wandered all over the sandbank.
"No." Li Tongya frowned, checked it carefully again, and took out five or six small river crabs.
Li Mutian smiled and waved his hand.
With his savings, the Li family can be said to be a prominent family in the village. Li Mutian bought more than ten acres of paddy field after returning from the army, plus more than five acres of fertile land inherited from his father, the total is nearly twenty acres.
"Father wants to learn the clan laws in the book, build an ancestral hall, open a clan mansion, study and become an official, and practice martial arts and generals."
The two of them were frightened by this turn of events. They looked at the white light surging on the mirror, and the moonlight turned into haloes and fell into the mirror one after another.
Li Tongya looked at his father, thought for a while, and then said:
Li Mutian said slowly that he had had this idea many years ago. His children were growing up day by day and the family was about to be separated.
Li Mutian sat at the red lacquered wooden table and listened to his two sons explain the whole story clearly. He nodded and said to Li Tongya:
"Well done."
It was precisely because the Li family had food and fields that his four children could read and write. That is to say, Li Mutian had never been used to wealthy people who were idle, so he required his children to study and farm every day, so that they could all eat well and live well when their families were divided in the future.
Sure enough, he felt a cool touch between his fingers and touched something smooth. He used two fingers to pull out a piece of jade about two fingers wide.
Li Mutian remembered the appearance of those wealthy families he saw in the city. The whole family was directly related to each other in the courtyard, studying as officials and practicing martial arts as generals and soldiers. How beautiful! On the other hand, the poor farmers are all divided completely. If you don’t take me, I won’t take you.
"That's it!"
"Third brother!"
"Wait a minute!" Li Tongya pulled him and shook his head:
"I'll get it. You wait on the shore with the diary. If the moon moves to that position, I haven't come back yet."
"The front and backyard of our house are not too small, and the backyard is close to the back mountain. I thought about the two melon fields in front and built two houses, guarding them on the left and right.It forms a large courtyard. As soon as the front door is closed, people unexpectedly peek in. "
Li Mutian's eyes lit up and he looked after the two children.
He went ashore and called lowly into the reeds, and Li Xiangping leaned out. Just when Li Tongya was about to show the jade, he opened his hand and the jade turned into a white light and fell into the mirror with a "whoosh".
“Go home first. "
"Now the family cannot be separated, and the daughter-in-law has to find someone of her own. "
Li Xiangping and Li Tongya looked at each other, and both saw surprise and joy in each other's eyes. Li Xiangping nodded vigorously, took off his clothes, and was about to step into the lake.
Li Tongya and Li Xiangping watched the jianzi in their hands slowly calm down after swallowing the jade, and the white light gradually dimmed.
“My Li family has been saving for two hundred years, and it’s time. "
He pointed to the sky.
The jade was in the shape of a long strip, with some writing patterns engraved on it. Li Tongya looked at the moonlight and identified:
"Tai...yue...qi...yanglun..." He could only read a few characters in a scribble. Li Tongya went to his husband to read the characters when he was young. He could recognize most of the characters, but the patterns on this jade stone were complicated and difficult to identify.
————
The golden-red morning glow climbed up into the sky and fell on Li Tongya's naked upper body, revealing golden lines. He lowered his head and said to his brother:
"Go to the field and call your eldest brother back to level the foundation. Just leave the field to the tenants. Your fourth brother doesn't have to pick mulberries in the afternoon. From now on, he will study at your teacher's place all day. "
"Yes..." Li Xiangping began to cry unknowingly, wiping his tears and looking at his second brother.
Lijing Village is good at water and soil for nourishing people, and the reed marshes and tidal flats are treasures for survival.
"Just hide the sword in the reeds and run to Guli Road, don't go home. "Li Tongya looked at his brother solemnly. "Wait until the sun rises three poles before coming back to check the situation. "
Looking calmly at the shore, he held the jade in his hands and swam towards the shore.
Li Tongya smiled and took off his clothes, revealing his strong arms, turned around and swam into the lake, leaving Li Xiangping hiding in the reeds and staring blankly at his brother.
"Okay. "Li Xiangping was still full of energy after struggling all night. After hearing this, he went out in a hurry.
He had been to Wangyue Lake with his father and brothers a few years ago. He swam back and forth countless times and swam to the center of the lake with ease.
"As for studying and practicing martial arts, the Guli Road is extremely dangerous. If you go in and out of Dali Mountain, you will die nine times. Even if you study and practice martial arts, you won't be able to sell it to the emperor of Yue. It's just a matter of looking for someone to inherit the family business and protect yourself..."
If labor is removed, twenty acres of land can feed more than ten people in good years. The Li family has long been at a level where they can close their doors and become landlords.
Li Tongya nodded and said in a low voice:
"There is nothing better than studying and practicing martial arts. "
"Don't talk nonsense here. "
Li Mutian laughed loudly, patted Li Tongya on the shoulder, raised his head and went out with his hands behind his back.
(End of chapter)
